def transform(grid):
    """Keep the marked cells above the divider that overlap filled cells below it."""
    divider = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(x == row[0] for x in row) and row[0] != 0)
    top = grid[:divider]
    bottom = grid[divider + 1:]
    return [[2 if a != 0 and b != 0 else 0 for a, b in zip(upper, lower)]
            for upper, lower in zip(top, bottom)]
